original: Welcome to The Sims 3 Tutorial! Here you will learn the basic gameplay of The Sims 3. When you are ready to proceed touch the Tutorial icon in the right hand corner.
replacement: 3D stays on the top screen with only the blue/green cursor. Read the tutorial and touch Continue on the bottom screen. All game UI also belongs on the bottom.

original: Touch where in the world you would like to move your Sim with the stylus. Depending on what you touch, there might be multiple options that appear - select the one you wish your Sim to perform.
replacement: Move the blue cursor with the D-Pad. Usable targets turn green. Press A and choose actions on the bottom screen. B cancels. The top screen shows only 3D.

original: Summary pages on the top screen contain critical information about your Sim and his life.  The L Button and R Button cycle through them.
replacement: Tutorial and Sim details go below. Touch arrows to switch pages. The top screen only shows 3D and cursor.
